messages.summary:
## Objective
- Build a complete, playable 3D WWII-inspired action game with moving enemy NPCs, HD-style visuals, and many effects.

## Requirements
- User requested: “3d bergerak npc bot musuh bot hd seperti call of duty ww2 3d banyak efek”.
- Build it now without clarification; make reasonable assumptions.

## Decisions
- Replaced the existing 2D side-scrolling game with a first-person Three.js Normandy beach battle.
- Used procedural low-poly environments, articulated enemy soldiers, weapons, lighting, smoke, muzzle flashes, tracers, hit effects, and touch controls.

## Work State
### Completed
- Reworked `index.html` with Indonesian title/menu, responsive HUD, controls, pause and end screens.
- Added `game.js` implementing Three.js scene, battlefield, first-person weapon, NPC enemy AI/combat, effects, and keyboard/mouse/touch input.
- `node --check game.js` passed.

### Active
- Browser-test the game, including starting and playing, and inspect a screenshot.

### Blocked
- `playwright-cli open http://localhost:3002` failed because Playwright’s expected Chromium binary is missing: `Browser "chromium" is not installed; expected executable at /home/runner/.cache/ms-playwright/chromium-1243/chrome-linux64/chrome`.
- System Chromium exists at `/usr/bin/chromium`; browser test has not yet been retried using another route.

## Next Move
1. Try `playwright-cli install-browser chromium`, or configure browser testing to use `/usr/bin/chromium`.
2. Run the game in a browser, inspect console errors and latest screenshot, and fix any issues.
3. Check `git status`; changes are currently uncommitted.

## Relevant Files
- `index.html`: Game UI, styles, Three.js CDN and `game.js` import.
- `game.js`: Game logic, procedural 3D scene, enemies and controls.

## Important Context
- A local server was started with `python3 -m http.server 3002` and is still running.
- Three.js loads from `https://cdn.jsdelivr.net/npm/three@0.160.0/build/three.min.js`; game initialization currently stops if `window.THREE` is unavailable.
- The user’s requested experience is an original WWII-inspired game, not a literal recreation.

## Objective
- Build a complete, playable 3D WWII-inspired action game with moving enemy NPCs, HD-style visuals, and effects.

## Requirements
- User requested: “3d bergerak npc bot musuh bot hd seperti call of duty ww2 3d banyak efek”.
- Build it now without clarification; make reasonable assumptions.

## Decisions
- Created an original first-person Normandy beach battle with procedural Three.js scenery, enemy AI/combat, weapons, effects, and touch controls.
- Used Indonesian UI and controls.

- Replaced the prior game UI and implemented the 3D game in `index.html` and `game.js`.
- Added moving enemy riflemen, three weapons, shooting/reloading, damage and win/loss states, smoke, tracers, muzzle flashes, and mobile controls.
- Browser-tested starting and playing: firing reduced ammo; switching weapons updated the weapon and ammo HUD.
